# iosxe_privilege (Resource)

This resource can manage the Privilege configuration for one command mode. It owns the whole `privilege <mode>` entry: destroying it, or changing `levels`, deletes the mode and recreates the configured commands, which also removes mappings in that mode that the resource does not manage. IOS-XE also assigns every command whose syntax is a subset of a configured command (for example `show` for `show interfaces`) to the same level. Plans ignore those extra entries, but `terraform import` reads them, so after an import either list them in `levels` or expect the first plan to replace the mode.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_privilege" "example" {
  mode = "exec"
  levels = [
    {
      level = 7
      commands = [
        {
          command = "ping"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) Command mode that the commands belong to.
  - Choices: `configure`, `crypto-map`, `exec`, `interface`, `ipenacl`, `router`

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `levels` (Attributes List) Privilege levels and the commands assigned to each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--levels))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--levels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `levels`

Required:

- `level` (Number) Privilege level the commands are assigned to.
  - Range: `0`-`15`

Optional:

- `commands` (Attributes List) Commands assigned to this privilege level. IOS-XE also assigns every command whose syntax is a subset of the command (for example `show` for `show interfaces`) to the same level. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--levels--commands))

<a id="nestedatt--levels--commands"></a>
### Nested Schema for `levels.commands`

Required:

- `command` (String) Command name, for example `ping` or `show interfaces`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_privilege.example "<mode>"
```
